question: Can a within-bounds revision of the per-event accessible deposit (accessible = max(accessible, target) on propensity-fired stool events) produce Liu's post-bathroom < routine ordering while pooled occupancy stays in [1/3, 3]?

sweep.method: paired counterfactual: engines/transmission_core.py deposit line scaled to target*F, all other terms untouched; the change consumes no RNG (voyage draw streams verified identical across F: same propensity lists, same stool-event witness counts modulo downstream divergence). classic_cruise_1900, seeds 8000+8001, 288 epochs, hygiene_cycle, instrument fomite_mass_balance+hand_occupancy; folds via the frozen _Fold in tools/noro_diag/hand_occupancy_readout.py
sweep.note: F=0.0001 deposit (~0.7 GEC at peak titre, ~200x below the 141-GEC rinse LOD) still reads event_higher +6pp. Scaling is monotone in effect but the sign never approaches a flip. R stays in the [1/3,3] band at every F.

census_cells_F1.note: composition_predicted = routine within-strata positivity reweighted to the event arm's symptomatic share. On seed 8005 it reproduces the measured event share to within 0.2pp; 8000 keeps a within-stratum premium (propensity-correlated protected carryover); 8105 splits the difference. Event positivity tracks the protected>=LOD row share nearly exactly on all three cells.

sourced_floor_per_event_deposit.evidence: routine-hand indicator envelope 10^-6.9..-4.1 g/hand (tranche 39); Oie 2021 post-defecation 39,499+/-77,768 CFU/glove without bidet (tranche 39/40, denominator ?nr); Wang 2017 SaniPath hand-rinse E. coli 2.25-1.55e5 CFU/pair; Liu within-study bridge -3.5..-4.4 log10 g/hand (tranche 40). A fresh contaminating event's residue cannot sit below the routine residual it replenishes.
sourced_floor_per_event_deposit.declared: 10^-7.14 g-equiv (10^3.86 GEC at 10^11 peak) -- at/below the floor already

bounds.measured_insufficiency: ordering does not flip at F=1e-4 (deposit ~0.7 GEC, ~4 orders below the sourced floor): the fresh deposit contributes ~1pp of event positivity (3/303 rows at F=1); the arm gap is carried by propensity-correlated protected-compartment carryover plus symptomatic-epoch over-representation in the event arm (defecation rate is symptom-conditioned, tranche 32)

supersedes: the earlier attribution 'residual miss = event-deposit magnitude' (recorded under a3c76061) -- measured here as a minor term
open_decision: the frozen ordering criterion compares a symptom-biased event arm to an unconditioned routine arm; next declared-scope options: symptom-matched comparator in the readout (reweight the event arm to the routine symptomatic share), revisit the tranche-32 defecation-rate symptom gradient, or accept event_higher as the honest reading of post-bathroom epochs that over-sample shedding-peak days
